messages:
emma_cs: FYI Acadia sent back the security questionnaire and a DPA follow-up. They specifically called out KMS attestation + key rotation evidence, asking for items by EOD Fri. Can @olivia_ciso advise on what we can provide from hosted?

raj_engineer: We have a key rotation policy + logs but no 'KMS attestation' artifact. I can upload policy + redacted logs. Sample config snippet I can share quickly:
```yaml
keys:
  rotation_interval: 90d
  storage: cloud-kms
  access_control: iam
```

olivia_ciso: For SOC2-oriented requests we usually provide: rotation policy, redacted key-usage logs, and a KMS attestation note from infra. For hosted customers we do a scoped attestation mentioning multi-tenant protections. @emma_cs which deployment is Acadia on?

emma_cs: Hosted API (region: us-west1). They said they may move to Dedicated in Q3 but need evidence now to keep procurement moving. I'll tell them we can supply rotation policy + logs and are requesting KMS attestation. :pray:

matt_cs_manager: Heads-up — procurement flagged compliance as a make/break for renewal. If we can't turn this around fast it may escalate to execs. Raj, can infra produce an attestation or at least a timeline?

raj_engineer: I'll ping infra SRE and security ops. If we can't get a signed attestation in 48h we can provide a scoped operational statement + signed SOC2 artifact. Uploading policy now. @deploy-bot can you create a ticket so we don't lose track?

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-2190 - "Provide KMS attestation / scoped operational statement for Acadia". Assigned to @raj_engineer. Priority: P1. ETA: 48h. Link: https://issuetracker.redwood.com/INFRA-2190

emma_cs: Perfect — I'll send Acadia an interim update: 'we're collecting KMS attestation; attached: rotation policy + redacted logs; expecting attestation within 48h.' Saves us for renewal convo.

olivia_ciso: I'll redact logs for auditor consumption and place in secured drive: https://drive.redwood.com/acadia/soc2-evidence/ — will tag legal if any extra NDA metadata is required. :eyes:

raj_engineer: Uploaded artifacts: https://drive.redwood.com/acadia/key-rotation.pdf and https://drive.redwood.com/acadia/key-usage-redacted.log. Noted in INFRA-2190.

emma_cs: Thanks all. I'll update the onboarding checklist (step: compliance evidence) and add a renewal-risk note to the account: Acadia — medium risk until attestation is delivered. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:

olivia_ciso: Will follow up once attestation text is drafted for review.

matt_cs_manager: Thanks team — keeping this visible in renewal tracker.
